findings: NON-BLOCKING: The integration suite now requires ADMIN_DATABASE_URL (slice 10, 1c2b01b, apps/api/test/rls/assert-test-role.ts), but apps/api/.env.dev.example still says 'Optional admin DB override. Leave blank' and the developer's real apps/api/.env has no ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, so `pnpm --filter @fxl-sales/api test:integration` refuses out of the box. The refusal is loud and names the fix; suite is green once set. Recommend documenting the TEST_* and ADMIN_DATABASE_URL local values in .env.dev.example (or letting adminUrl fall back to the already-local TEST_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL) and telling the user to add the line to apps/api/.env.
NON-BLOCKING: Resend/revoke do not apply the cross-org refusal to legacy sellers with NULL invited_org_id; documented in admin-service.ts and the Hub still scopes by the actor token.
